title: Deep into the Secret Realm
next_chapter_hook: Strange movements came from the depths of the secret realm, as if someone had already sensed the presence of invaders

text.content: The night was as dark as ink, and the miasma at the entrance of the Holy Sect's secret realm writhed like a living creature on the mountain walls, emitting a nauseatingly fishy-sweet scent. Chen Ji stood behind a huge boulder, the sharp light in his eyes flickering and disappearing instantly, a self-deprecating curve forming at the corner of his lips. The Holy Sect servant robe he wore was slightly too loose, with several withered leaves still clinging to the sleeves, looking utterly like a waste product just pulled from the pile of Outer Disciples' servants. "Waste persona, traveling the world." He silently repeated these four words in his heart, fingertips gently stroking the Tianji Record Fragment hidden in his sleeve, feeling that familiar yet dangerous surge of power. In the distance, Chen Nian's Heavenly Fate aura was still剧烈震颤— he closed his eyes, taking three breaths to confirm he could still sense that faint bloodline connection. That was proof his sister was still alive. That was enough.

dialogue.content: "Your disguise is even more convincing than mine as a Holy Sect person." Ye Qing glided silently to his side, a layer of black纱 obscuring most of her face, revealing only a pair of deep, dark eyes. Under the moonlight, those eyes carried a playful glint. "Waste persona— Chen Ji, your scheming is quite masterful."

text.content: Chen Ji didn't respond, merely tilting his head slightly, his gaze sweeping across the faintly visible light curtain ahead—the first layer barrier of the secret realm. Miasma churned like tides at the barrier's edge, emitting soft hissing sounds, as if countless insects and ants were watching from the shadows. He noticed the guards' shift change had a three-breath gap, enough for two people to approach silently. But the real test began the moment they stepped through the barrier. "Night Saint." He lowered his voice, his tone calm as if discussing today's weather, "Once we're inside, you handle the mechanisms, I play the fool. Remember—no matter what happens—don't laugh."

choice.prompt: Final confirmation before the infiltration begins— what strategy do you choose?

choices.description: Strictly adhere to the waste persona, never proactively expose any anomalies, rather miss opportunities than take risks.
choices.process_label: suppress aura and blend into shadows

text.content: Chen Ji收敛起 all edges, spine slightly hunched, dragging his feet, his entire being emitting a timid, cowardly aura. He walked with the characteristic shuffling steps of a servant who had been bullied for years, shoulders occasionally twitching, as if随时会被吓得原地蹲下. Ye Qing's眼角微抽— if she hadn't witnessed it herself, she would never have believed anyone could embody the word "trash" so masterfully.

choices.description: Maintain the waste persona while using the Tianji Record to briefly foresee three breaths of the future, capturing guard patrol patterns.
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate consumption may affect critical moments ahead

text.content: Golden light flickered once in Chen Ji's eyes. The scene three breaths ahead exploded in his mind— two guards would be chatting at the third withered tree on the left, with a half-breath blind spot in their vision. Enough. Without hesitation, he naturally adjusted his direction, still maintaining that cowering appearance, but his path精准得如同游鱼过隙, making not a single sound.

choices.description: Take advantage of the shift change gap to directly dash in at high speed, betting the guards won't react in time, suitable for time-critical situations.
choices.visible_reward: Save considerable time, directly reach core area

text.content: Chen Ji's gazesuddenly凌厉, his form blurring as he was about to dash out. However, the next moment, a hand precisely clamped his wrist, the force neither too light nor too heavy, yet carrying undeniable warning. "Impatient fellow." Ye Qing's voice rang in his ear, cold as tempered ice, "Do you think the Holy Sect barrier is your backyard?"

The two glided along the barrier's edge like two shadows, their timing for the guard shift change perfect. The instant they passed through the light curtain, Chen Ji felt a cold aura扑面而来, as if countless eyes were盯着 him from all directions. The secret realm's first layer was more bizarre than he'd imagined— jet-black ancient trees towered skyward, their trunks covered in dark red vines like solidified blood vessels. The ground was littered with piles of white bones, some still frozen in struggling poses, silently accusing something. Ye Qing suddenly stopped, her slender fingers pointing vaguely three zhang ahead. "Floor tiles." Her voice was extremely low, "Step on the wrong one, and ten zhang in all directions become powder."

Chen Ji concentrated仔细看, and indeed discovered the blue stone tiles on the ground varied in color— some glowed with eerie phosphorescence, others dull as dead ash. For ordinary people, the danger would be invisible. But for him, this was merely an appetizer. The real question was— what was the mechanism's pattern? Ye Qing suddenly轻笑一声, her fair hand forming a strange印诀. A layer of pale purple mist surged from her palm, silently spreading to engulf that dangerous area. "Demonic Path Mist." She explained, "Can conceal the Tianji Record's aura— though useless against ordinary mechanisms, can shield you from prying eyes."

dialogue.content: "Watch closely." Ye Qing's lips slightly raised, a flash of pride flickering in her eyes, "Mechanisms of this level are merely fences to keep out beasts in the Holy Sect's eyes."

text.content: Her fingertips连连点数,一个个玄奥的符文在空中勾勒成型,随即没入地面. Those tiles glowing with phosphorescence actually sank slowly underground like驯服的野兽, revealing a passage just wide enough for two people side by side. "Go." Ye Qing stepped in first, Chen Ji following closely. As they passed through the passage, Chen Ji noticed the walls were covered密密麻麻的符文, emanating a faint blue glow. "This is the Holy Sect's 'Heavenly Fate Lock Formation.'" Ye Qing's voice came from ahead, carrying a hint of gravity, "Specifically designed to deal with— those things of yours."

Chen Ji's steps微顿. "Those things of yours"— she was referring to the Tianji Record. Master Mo had once mentioned that Heavenly Secrets Record holders would be tracked by Heavenly Will, and it wasn't strange that a deeply intertwined Holy Sect and Demonic Path势力 would possess some counter-measures. His fingers unconsciously brushed the fragment in his sleeve, feeling a faint躁动— as if the Tianji Record had also sensed the Lock Formation's aura, issuing a silent warning. "Don't touch those runes." Ye Qing suddenly looked back, her speech pace faster than usual, "The Lock Formation has感应towards the Tianji Record— once triggered—" Before she finished,整齐的脚步声suddenly响起 around the corner ahead.

choice.prompt: Patrol team suddenly appears, less than ten zhang away— how do you respond?

choices.description: Maintain servant identity, pretend to be a pitiful wretch dragged here to do errands, reduce the other's vigilance before seeking a chance to escape.
choices.visible_cost: May be forced into more humiliating postures
choices.risk_hint: If exposed, will be completely exposed

dialogue.content: Chen Ji instinctively hunched lower, shoulders剧烈颤抖, his face filled with panic and servility. He huddled into the corner, hands covering his head, voice带着哭腔: "D-Don't kill me... I was just dragged here to carry things... I don't know anything..." This performance was so natural, even he almost believed it.

choices.description: Use eye contact to signal Ye Qing to strike first, subdue or eliminate the patrol team while they are unprepared.
choices.risk_hint: If patrol team has reinforcements, will be surrounded

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze微闪, his right hand making a subtle gesture in his sleeve. A murderous glint flashed in Ye Qing's eyes, her slender form drifting out like a specter, black纱leaving a afterimage in the air. The lead patrol soldier didn't even have time to发出警报 before being enveloped by诡异的黑雾, collapsing softly. The remaining two惊觉不对, just about to cry for help when Chen Ji had already欺身而上— his movements still clumsy, but precisely covering one person's mouth, while ramming the other towards Ye Qing's direction with clever force.

choices.description: Temporarily avoid theedge, use the complex terrain within the secret realm to evade the patrol team, preserve strength waiting for the next opportunity.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain complete combat capability, avoid unnecessary fighting
choices.risk_hint: May fall deeper into the secret realm's labyrinth

text.content: Chen Ji's form flashed, already gliding into the shadow of a withered ancient tree nearby. He gestured to Ye Qing— retreat, don't fight. Holy Sect patrol teams were绝非等闲之辈, each at least Foundation Building late stage, once caught in entanglement,只会引来更多的麻烦. Ye Qing understood, her black雾一收, silently concealing beside Chen Ji. The two like two游鱼, silently withdrawing through the shadows.

dialogue.content: "They'll wake in three breaths but won't remember seeing us." Ye Qing's voice reached Chen Ji's ear, carrying a slight gasp, "That strike just now, cost me quite a bit." Chen Ji slightly tilted his head,借着微弱的幽光打量她的脸色— indeed several shades paler than before. Demonic Path secret arts were powerful, yet clearly not without cost.

text.content: He silently记下 this debt. Not bearing a grudge— but记恩. Though Ye Qing was the Demonic Path Saint, their cooperation was merely利益交换, yet she had毫不hesitated地出手相护 without hesitation, this favor he acknowledged. "There's a fork ahead." Chen Ji lowered his voice, gaze sweeping the three passages ahead, "The left one has the weakest aura— should lead to the outskirts; the middle one has Heavenly Fate Lock Formation aura— should be the core area; the right one..." He paused,瞳孔微缩, "has a living person's aura, and more than one."

choice.prompt: Three passages lie before you— Chen Ji, which do you choose?

choices.description: Take the left passage with the weakest aura— slower, but can preserve strength to the maximum, leaving room for subsequent actions.
choices.risk_hint: May encounter more random dangers in the secret realm

text.content: Chen Ji didn't hesitate, leading Ye Qing into the left passage. This path was narrower than anywhere they'd passed before, the rocky walls covered in fluorescent moss, illuminating the surroundings like an underwater world. In the silence, only the sounds of their breathing and occasional water droplets. Just as they were about to reach the passage's end, a strange humming suddenly echoed ahead, as if something was awakening.

choices.description: Directly take the middle passage with Heavenly Fate Lock Formation aura— that's most likely where Chen Nian is imprisoned, but also most dangerous.
choices.visible_cost: Extremely high risk, may trigger multiple mechanisms
choices.visible_reward: Most likely to find Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: Every step may be a trap

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's steps didn't hesitate in the slightest. His sister had been missing for years— this was the closest he'd been to her. The Heavenly Fate Lock Formation's aura was indeed dangerous, but so what? He silently念道 in his heart: Chen Nian, wait for me. Even if the Heavenly Fate Lock Formation was truly set for him, he would闯上一闯. Ye Qing seemed to sense thedetermined的气息 emanating from him, a complex glint flickering in her eyes, but she said nothing, merely watching the surroundings more vigilantly.

choices.description: Go to the right passage where living aura exists, investigate what hides there— perhaps ally, perhaps enemy.
choices.visible_reward: May obtain unexpected intelligence or assistance
choices.risk_hint: Opposing party's identity unknown, may be a trap

text.content: A meaningful smile formed at the corner of Chen Ji's lips. Living person's aura— deep within the Holy Sect's secret realm, if not guards, then prisoners, or... another unlucky soul who infiltrated where they shouldn't be. He made a silencing gesture to Ye Qing, the two like two phantoms, silently approaching the right passage. The deeper they went, the clearer that living aura became, and faint低低的交谈声 could also be heard. Chen Ji pricked up his ears, catching several key words— "Tianji Record" "Chen Family" "Sacrifice." His瞳孔suddenly收缩.

Chen Ji死死地盯着 Ye Qing's eyes, voice极低, yet carrying undeniable coldness: "Sacrifice? Who is to be sacrificed?" Ye Qing didn't answer, merely extending her hand to point towards a direction deep in the passage— where faint锁链拖地的沉闷声响 echoed, accompanied by若有若无的呜咽. Chen Ji's heart猛地一沉. That sound... was very familiar. Familiar到让他骨髓发寒. It was the sound his mother made when the Holy Sect disciples dragged her away on her deathbed.

dialogue.content: "Don't act rashly." Ye Qing suddenly grabbed his wrist, her grip unexpectedly heavy, "You calm down— I agreed to cooperate with you because you could show me that prophecy. But if you go crazy now, I don't mind completing the rest alone." Her voice was cold, but the眼底深处却藏着一丝旁人难以察觉的worried, "Master Mo said your sister carries the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, which can interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight. The sacrifice... may not be her."

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes. Three breaths. Five breaths. Ten breaths. When he opened them again, thatmurderous almost breaking through his sanity had been压制入深渊深处, replaced by an令人心悸的calm. "You're right." His voice恢复了他惯常的detached, "Sacrifice like this... the Holy Sect has done more than once. What they need is 'Heavenly Secrets Blood,' not 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key.'" He released Ye Qing's hand, turning to continue deeper into the passage. This time, his steps were steadier than ever. Ye Qing看着他的背影, a complex glint flickering in her eyes. This man... was more terrifying than she imagined. No, wrong. Was more able to endure than she imagined.

The passage suddenly opened up, a huge underground altar appearing before the two. At the altar's center burned ghostly green flames, within which a vague figure was suspended by chains in mid-air. Around the altar stood seven or eight Holy Sect disciples in black robes,whispered吟唱着古老的咒文. Chen Ji's gaze越过那些人, falling on a bronze mirror behind the altar— in the mirror was映出的不是周围的景象, but a face he'd dreamed of魂牵梦萦. Chen Nian. In the mirror, Chen Nian's eyes were tightly closed, brow furrowed, as if experiencing some terrible nightmare. Around her同样环绕着无数锁链, echoing with the figure at the altar's center. "Twin Sacrifice..." Ye Qing's voice came from behind,带着一丝grave, "They intend to use the blood connection between two people to open a door that should never be opened."

dialogue.content: "What's behind that door?" Chen Ji's voice was very light,轻得像在问今天吃什么. Ye Qing沉默了片刻,才slowly开口: "I don't know. But the Holy Sect has prepared for this moment for at least twenty years." Twenty years. Chen Ji重复这个数字 in his heart. He had离开陈念已经整整 eighteen years. Plus the two years before she disappeared, exactly twenty years. "Enough." He suddenly spoke, his voice听不出任何情绪, "Knowing this much is enough."

text.content: The moment his words fell, the ghostly green flames on the altar suddenly剧烈跳动. Those Holy Sect disciples吟唱咒文纷纷停下动作,面面相觑. "What's happening?" "Why is the flame..." The next moment, a苍老而sinister的声音 suddenly rang from the altar's depths: "Some mice have slipped in." Chen Ji's瞳孔suddenly收缩. Before the words even faded, a terrifyingimposing erupted from the altar's center, enveloping the entire space. Chains rattled loudly, the vague figure in mid-airabruptly睁开眼— those were浑浊的、布满血丝的眼睛, yet carrying某种令人心悸的穿透力, directly gazing towards where Chen Ji and Ye Qing were hiding. "Tianji Record holder... I've been waiting for you, for a long time."

Chen Ji didn't move. He merely stood quietly in place, allowing thatimposing如潮水般冲刷着他的身体. His face showed no fear, no anger,甚至没有nervous— only an近乎漠然的calm. Ye Qing's hand had already悄悄按上了腰间的artifact,随时准备出手. However, the next moment, her body僵住了. Because she saw Chen Ji raise his hand, making a让所有人都始料未及的动作— he untied the bindings at his sleeve,褪下那件宽大的杂役袍服, revealing a pale green robe underneath that had been washed countless times. "Tianqing Sect Servant Disciple, Chen Ji." His voice wasn't loud, yet clearly传遍了整个祭坛, "Elders... seeking the Tianji Record? I'm afraid you'll be disappointed. That thing—" A讥诮的弧度 formed at the corner of his lips, "is simply not on my person."
